user.title: Tiles for Luma
user.description: Choose the lights, switches, covers, scenes and scripts that should appear on the TV.

names.title: Names on the TV
names.description: Type the name you want on the television, the same one you use on the tablet. Home Assistant keeps its own name. Leave a field as-is to use the system name. 40 characters.

token.title: Code for the TV
token.description:
You can type this code in Luma, or pair with the QR code from the integration options.

{token}

abort.single_instance_allowed: Luma Bridge is already set up.
abort.paired: The TV is connected. Tiles show up on the Luma home screen.

init.title: Luma
init.description: Pair the TV with the QR code, or change the tiles.

menu_options.pair: Pair the TV with a QR code

doorbell.title: Doorbell and camera
doorbell.description: Pick the gate button and the camera. When someone rings, the TV opens that picture. Submit with both fields empty to turn this off.

data_description.doorbell: The sensor or button that turns on when someone presses the gate bell.
data_description.doorbell_camera: The camera whose picture should open on the television.

pair.title: Pair the TV
pair.description: On the TV open Settings, Home Assistant, QR code. Then open this page on your phone and point the camera at the TV.

tiles.title: Luma tiles
tiles.description: TV code: {token}. On the next screen you set the name shown on the TV.

names.title: Names on the TV
names.description: Type the name for the television. The Home Assistant name does not change.

abort.paired: The TV is connected. Tiles show up on the Luma home screen.
